company_name: Wuxi Wof New Material Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in high-purity semiconductor materials essential for semiconductor process equipment.
summary: Wuxi Wof New Material Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, and production of high-purity fluoroplastics, particularly PFA and N-PTFE, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes. Their products are utilized in piping and lining for semiconductor equipment and in the wet electronic chemicals industry.

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Wuxi City, Jiangsu Province, within a cluster of national-level semiconductor enterprises.
